title: Batman: Knightfall - Part 1: Knightfall
plot_overview: After Arkham Asylum is destroyed, dangerous inmates flood Gotham City. A determined vigilante races to contain the chaos, but relentless battles push him toward physical and mental exhaustion as he faces a calculating new enemy who is determined to break him.
will_you_like_this: You’ll like this if you enjoy serious, brutal superhero stories centered on psychological pressure and a hero pushed beyond his limits; Not for you if you want a complete standalone film or lighter adventure.
review_summary: Pros: compelling central conflict; strong voice performances; dark atmosphere | Cons: condensed storytelling; uneven animation; deliberate opening pace
